message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# GitHub actions workflow.
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/learn-github-actions/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions

name: Build+Test CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

  schedule:
    # The GH mirroring from Google GoB does not trigger push actions.
    # Fire it every other day to provide some coverage.  This will run ~8 AM PT.
    - cron: '39 3 */2 * *'

  # Allow for manual triggers from the web.
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  autotools:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            cc: gcc
            cxx: g++
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            cc: clang
            cxx: clang++
          - os: macos-latest
            cc: clang
            cxx: clang++
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      CC: ${{ matrix.cc }}
      CXX: ${{ matrix.cxx }}

    steps:
    - name: System settings
      run: |
        set -x
        $CC --version
        $CXX --version
        getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN
        getconf _NPROCESSORS_CONF
        true

    - name: Checkout depot_tools
      run: git clone --depth=1 https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/tools/depot_tools.git ../depot_tools

    - name: Checkout breakpad
      run: |
        set -xe
        PATH+=:$PWD/../depot_tools
        gclient config --unmanaged --name=src https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}
        gclient sync --no-history --nohooks

    # First build & test in-tree.
    - run: ./configure --disable-silent-rules
      working-directory: src
    - run: make -j$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_CONF)
      working-directory: src
    - run: make -j$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_CONF) check VERBOSE=1
      working-directory: src
    - run: make -j$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_CONF) distclean
      working-directory: src

    # Then build & test out-of-tree.
    - run: mkdir -p src/build/native
    - run: ../../configure --disable-silent-rules
      working-directory: src/build/native
    - run: make -j$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_CONF) distcheck VERBOSE=1
      working-directory: src/build/native",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a 3-cell matrix with fail-fast: false, so all cells continue after a failure. Evidence pattern P-LIT-FAIL-FAST (experiment records batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242 and batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997, outcome scenario_passed) supports canceling remaining matrix jobs after a failure to save CI resources. The change is minimal: set fail-fast to true. All build and test steps are preserved; only redundant matrix execution after a failure is avoided. No permissions are weakened, no secrets or network access added, and no publishing/deployment operations introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-FAIL-FAST", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242"]
}
